macro.text: Middle East tensions rose after US strikes hit Iran's Qeshm Island and Houthis hit Aramco's Riyadh HQ
Gold extended its recent slide as Goldman detailed the drivers behind the sell-off
Tariffs face a fresh challenge as Democrats vow to unwind them after winning the House
French protests drew 146,000 people for a fourth straight weekend over living costs
Stock correlations hit a record low, a signal that preceded the latest tech-driven sell-off
China's AI boom showed cracks, clouding Beijing's ambitions to build a 'Wall Street East'

corporate.note: Berkshire more than doubled Q3 buybacks even as operating profit declined, shares outperforming the S&P this week
Chief strategy officer Dave Wehner departs to become CFO of AI infra startup Fireworks, valued at $17.5B
Amazon is rebuilding its home-robotics push after Astro struggled, hiring for a new robot product
Anthropic's planned IPO runs into AI backlash after midterms showed voter unease with data-center buildout
Cabaletta Bio released phase 1/2 data for its autoimmune cell therapy

frontPage.watch: Watch for further Iran/Gulf headlines to drive oil and gold, while thin equity breadth and the AI-earnings bar keep indices volatile.

esForecast.footnote: Ranges cover the full ~23-hour futures session, not just the New York cash session. Sample 3734 sessions from 2012-01-01. Model: ln(next range %) = -5.836 + 0.970×ln(VIX) + 0.315×ln(ATR5 %), R² 54%. Out-of-sample band hit rate 47%. On FOMC, payrolls and CPI days the range is raised 23%, 15% and 6% (how much bigger those sessions ran than the model, 2012-2026).
